concepts.title: Sun over hills
concepts.why: Minimal landscapes sell across living rooms and bedrooms, and 'sunset wall art' and 'sage green wall art' show steady demand with lighter competition.
concepts.prompt: Minimal flat-colour landscape: a large burnt-orange sun low over three layered rolling hills in sand, sage and deep forest green, on a pale peach sky. Two tiny birds. Simple hand-cut shapes, no texture, mid-century poster feel.

concepts.title: Good morning coffee
concepts.why: Coffee prints are a steady kitchen gift, and 'coffee bar decor' and 'retro kitchen wall art' point to a retro, cheerful style.
concepts.prompt: Retro kitchen poster on mustard yellow: a cream coffee cup with a blue band on a saucer, three wavy lines of steam, and the words GOOD MORNING in a clean dark sans-serif across the top.

concepts.title: Single-line botanical
concepts.why: Line-art botanicals have strong searches but heavy competition; a simple olive branch keeps it distinct.
concepts.prompt: Single continuous black line drawing of an olive branch on warm off-white, generous empty space, minimalist.
